posts.text: Last week, our paper, “B.A.I.L.I.F.F.”, won Best Paper at the Canadian Undergraduate Conference on Artificial Intelligence (CUCAI)🏅 B.A.I.L.I.F.F. stands for Bias Analysis in Interactive Legal Intelligence and Fairness Framework. Our work asks a simple but important question for legal AI: is strong performance enough if the process used to reach that result is unfair?
